Second 1.x roadmap item. Closes the long-running-server gap: edits
to the vault while the MCP server is alive are now visible to the
parsed-note cache and (when --persistent-index is also on) to the
FTS5 index, without requiring a server restart.

- Vault-rooted file watcher started AFTER the initial FTS5 sync, so
  no double-indexing on boot.
- On .md add/change/unlink, the cache entry for that file is
  invalidated;

120s timeout, silently capping any tool whose SSE response exceeds that
boundary regardless of the configured tool_timeout_secs (valid up to
600s). Introduce http_client_timeout_secs() to compute max(tool_timeout,
120) and use it as the client-wide timeout, ensuring the reqwest layer
never fires before the configured per-call budget.
